teaser.en: A buttressed timber giant of lowland forest whose winged seeds sail out of long flat pods, now officially Vulnerable.
teaser.sw: Jitu la mbao lenye mizizi-ukuta la misitu ya nyanda za chini ambalo mbegu zake zenye mabawa hupeperuka kutoka kwenye maganda marefu bapa, na sasa limeorodheshwa rasmi kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
teaser.dg: Muhi mkulu wa mbao wenye ngamba, wa matsaka ga tsi za photsi, ambao tembeze zenye mapha zinatuluka kula makakaya mare na mabapa na kuhalwa ni phepho. Sambi ukaandikpwa rasmi kahi ya mihi iriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*).

summary.en: *Mleha* is a large buttressed tree of lowland and riverine forest, a popular Digo timber species. It is listed by the IUCN as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Mleha* ni mti mkubwa wenye mizizi-ukuta wa misitu ya nyanda za chini na ya kando ya mito, na ni spishi maarufu ya mbao kwa Wadigo. IUCN imeuorodhesha kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mleha* ni muhi mkulu wenye ngamba, wa matsaka ga tsi za photsi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, na ni mwenga wa mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo. IUCN inauandika kahi ya mihi iriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*).

about.en: *Mleha* is a big forest tree with buttresses at the base. Its leaves are twice divided, with only a few pairs of leaflets. The pods are long and flat, and they release winged seeds that drift on the wind.
about.sw: *Mleha* ni mti mkubwa wa msituni wenye mizizi-ukuta chini yake. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili, yakiwa na jozi chache tu za vijani. Maganda yake ni marefu na bapa, na huachilia mbegu zenye mabawa zinazopeperushwa na upepo.
about.dg: *Mleha* ni muhi mkulu wa tsaka wenye ngamba photsi. Makodzage ganaganyika mara mbiri, na gana jozi chache bahi za makodza madide. Makakaya ni mare na mabapa, na ganalavya tembe zenye mapha zinazohalwa ni phepho.

where.en: It grows in lowland and riverine forest, between about 75 and 300 metres above sea level.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya nyanda za chini na ya kando ya mito, kati ya mita 75 na 300 hivi juu ya usawa wa bahari.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga tsi za photsi na ga kanda-kanda ya miho, kula phephi mita 75 hadi 300 dzulu ya bahari.

uses.en: Pakia lists *mleha* among the popular timber species of the Digo.
uses.sw: Pakia anaorodhesha *mleha* miongoni mwa spishi maarufu za mbao za Wadigo.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika *mleha* kahi ya mihi ya mbao inayomendzwa ni Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mleha*. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Newtonia paucijuga*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mleha*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Newtonia paucijuga*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mleha*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Newtonia paucijuga*.

conservation.en: Mleha is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List.
conservation.sw: Mleha umeorodheshwa kuwa Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN.
conservation.dg: *Mleha* ukaandikpwa kahi ya mihi iriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*) kpwenye *IUCN Red List*.

reason.en: Another forest timber tree of the bean family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa mbao wa msituni wa jamii ya kunde
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa mbao wa tsaka, wa jamii ya kunde

reason.en: Major timber tree, also becoming rare
reason.sw: Mti mkuu wa mbao, pia unazidi kuwa adimu
reason.dg: Muhi mkulu wa mbao, naye piya unakala adimu

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa pwani ulio Hatarini (Vulnerable)
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa pwani uriyo hatarini (*Vulnerable*)
Mbao nono kuriko zosi, sambi ni adimu
